profile.subject: a red Shiba Inu dog
profile.styleHints: red-tan coat, white chest and legs, curled fluffy tail, erect ears, fox face

cycle.prompt: same red Shiba Inu dog with cream chest and legs, curled fluffy tail over back, erect ears, in strict side profile facing right, one eye visible, walking in 4 frames with legs alternating in trot, head steady, same size in every frame, 4 equal columns with wide magenta gaps

lines: Hi I'm Kuma, let's run outside
My fluffy tail is super happy
I stand tall and proud today
I sniff fun trails that way
I love my sunny grassy spot

facts.text: Shiba Inus come from Japan and are one of its oldest dog breeds.
They look like little foxes with pointy ears and curly tails.
Shiba Inus are bold, loyal and smart, and act a bit like cats.
